about_short_description.short_description: Lumina is an online community for productive employees in that helps them find jobs quickly, easily, and safely.

product.name: Lumina Job Search Application
product.description: A mobile app that allows users to find and apply for verified job vacancies across Indonesia, with daily updates and direct communication with HR.

product.name: Automatic CV Builder
product.description: A feature within the Lumina app that generates a company-standard CV automatically from the user's profile information.

product.name: Online Skill Certification and Classes
product.description: Lumina offers free online classes and skill certification to help users improve their qualifications for career advancement or job changes.

product.name: Career Consultation Service
product.description: A service within Lumina that connects users with career experts for direct consultation and guidance.

product.name: Lumina Online Community
product.description: An online community platform within Lumina where users can connect, share information, and support each other in their job search and career development.
